SOC

Automatisation de la sécurité

Security Automation is the application of technology to perform repetitive or time-sensitive security operations tasks—such as detection, response, and remediation—without human intervention, typically using SOAR or automated scripting.

What is Automatisation de la sécurité?

In this glossary, Automatisation de la sécurité refers to: Security Automation is the application of technology to perform repetitive or time-sensitive security operations tasks—such as detection, response, and remediation—without human intervention, typically using SOAR or automated scripting.

How is Automatisation de la sécurité used in cybersecurity?

In cybersecurity communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "L'automatisation de la sécurité permet aux équipes SOC de contenir rapidement les menaces, d’orchestrer les flux de travail et de réduire les efforts manuels grâce à des playbooks et des intégrations."

Definition

Security Automation is the application of technology to perform repetitive or time-sensitive security operations tasks—such as detection, response, and remediation—without human intervention, typically using SOAR or automated scripting.

Operational example

Security automation enables SOC teams to rapidly contain threats, orchestrate workflows, and reduce manual effort through playbooks and integrations.
